description: Triage rules for Patient Intake Triage Assistant

rules.title: General Fever Assessment
follow_up_questions: What is the highest temperature recorded?
How long have you had the fever?
Do you have any other symptoms like cough, headache, or body aches?
Have you traveled anywhere recently?
Are you taking any medications for the fever?
rules.reasoning: General fever assessment based on temperature, duration, and associated symptoms.

rules.title: General Injury Assessment
follow_up_questions: How did the injury happen?
Where exactly is the pain?
Can you move the affected area?
Is there any bleeding?
When did the injury occur?
rules.reasoning: Injury assessment focusing on mechanism, location, and neurovascular status.

rules.title: Chest Pain Assessment
red_flags: chest pain radiating to arm or jaw
shortness of breath with chest pain
sweating and nausea with chest pain
follow_up_questions: Can you describe the pain (sharp, dull, pressure)?
Does the pain spread to your arm, jaw, or back?
Are you experiencing shortness of breath?
Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded?
Do you have a history of heart problems?
rules.reasoning: Chest pain requires immediate evaluation to rule out cardiac events.

rules.title: Breathing Difficulty Assessment
follow_up_questions: When did the breathing difficulty start?
Can you speak in full sentences?
Do you have a history of asthma or lung disease?
Are your lips or fingernails discolored?
Does anything make it better or worse?
rules.reasoning: Breathing difficulty requires rapid assessment to identify respiratory distress.

rules.title: Abdominal Pain Assessment
red_flags: inability to pass gas or stool
follow_up_questions: Where exactly is the pain located?
When did the pain start?
Can you describe the pain (cramping, sharp, burning)?
Have you noticed any blood in your stool or vomit?
When was your last bowel movement?
rules.reasoning: Abdominal pain assessment focuses on identifying surgical emergencies.
